name: ネオンサイバー
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 440px !important; height: 440px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 50px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.5)); margin: 0 !important; }

.roulette-border { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 480px; height: 480px; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; border: 4px solid #00ffff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff, 0 0 40px #00ffff, inset 0 0 20px #00ffff; animation: border-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }
.center-hub { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 100px; height: 100px; z-index: 10; }

.center-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; border: 3px solid #ff00ff; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ff00ff, inset 0 0 15px #ff00ff; animation: spin-slow 10s linear infinite; }

.center-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 70%; height: 70%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #1a1a3e 0%, #0a0a1e 100%); border: 2px solid #00ffff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff, inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.3); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
@keyframes spin-slow { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 55px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 40px; height: 60px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff00ff 0%, #00ffff 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 0 0, 100% 0); box-shadow: 0 0 20px #ff00ff, 0 0 40px #00ffff; z-index: 20; animation: pointer-glow 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 220px; height: 70px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; color: #000000; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ffff 0%, #ff00ff 100%); border: 3px solid #00ffff; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff, 0 0 40px #ff00ff, inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: all 0.3s ease; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 4px; position: absolute; clip-path: polygon(10% 0%, 100% 0%, 90% 100%, 0% 100%); top: 550px; }

#spinBtn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -2px; left: -2px; right: -2px; bottom: -2px; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #00ffff, #ff00ff, #00ffff); z-index: -1; filter: blur(10px); opacity: 0.7; }

#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #00ffff; text-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff, 0 0 30px #ff00ff; font-family: 'Arial Black', 'Arial', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 630px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 550px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(0, 0, 20, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #00ffff !important; color: #00ffff !important; }
